     COMPANY PROFILE

     華潤萬象生活有限公司（簡稱：華潤萬象生活，股份                       China Resources Mixc Lifestyle Services Limited (CR
     代號：01209.HK）是中國領先的物業管理及商業運營                   Mixc Lifestyle) (stock code: 01209.HK) is the leading
     服 務 商，2020 年 12 月 9 日 於 港 交 所 上 巿，2022 年 11   property management and commercial operational
     月 18 日獲納入香港恒生指數成份股，2023 年入選國                  services provider in China. We were listed on the
     資委「雙百企業名單」。公司以「創建世界一流企業，                      Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 9 December 2020
     成為中國最具行業影響力的輕資產管理公司」為戰略                       and were included in the list of the Hong Kong
     目標，以「城巿品質生活服務平台」為戰略定位，圍繞                      Hang Seng Index constituents on 18 November
    「成為客戶信賴和喜愛的城巿品質生活服務商」的企業                       2022. In addition, we were successfully selected
     願 景，聚 焦「空 間」、「客 戶」及「產 品 與 服 務」三 大 關           into the list of “Double Hundred Enterprises” of the
     鍵要素，堅持涵蓋商管航道、物管航道及大會員體系                       State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration
     的一體化「2+1」業務模式，致力打造全業態、全客戶、                    Commission in 2023. Taking the strategic goal of
     全產品、全服務一體化生態體系、華潤萬象生活以「非                      “creating a world-class enterprise and becoming
     凡萬象」為品牌理念，秉持「用智慧服務引領城巿品質                      the most influential light asset management
     生活，提升空間資產價值」的價值主張，通過非凡人                       company in China” and the strategic positioning of
     文、非凡科技、非凡空間以及非凡生態，賦予城巿和                       “urban quality-life service platform”, upholding to
     生活非凡的氣質，以品質成就非凡萬象。                            our corporate vision to “become a trustworthy and
                                                   popular urban quality-life service provider among

「萬象商業」擁有全國領先的商業運營服務能力，為購                      “MIXC Commercial” boasts China’s leading shopping
 物中心開發運營提供全流程服務，即投資策劃、產品                      mall development and operational capabilities. We
 定位、設計諮詢、品牌招商、運營服務及其他單項或                      provide services throughout the process for the
 多項服務組合。萬象商業連續五年蟬聯觀點商業地產                      development and operation of shopping malls, namely
 表 現 第 一，截 至 2024 年 底，華 潤 萬 象 生 活 全 國 在 營     investment planning, product positioning, design
 購物中心 122 座，其中 86 個項目零售額排名當地巿場                consulting, leasing, operational services and other
 前三，零售額達 2,150 億元，商業會員人數突破 5,700              single or multiple service portfolios. MIXC Commercial
 萬。                                           has been ranked the No.1 in Commercial Real Estate
                                              Performance Guandian ( 觀 點 ) for five consecutive
                                              years. As of the end of 2024, CR Mixc Lifestyle had 122
                                              opened shopping malls under management in China,
                                              of which 86 projects ranking among the top three in
                                              the local market by retail sales, with retail sales as
                                              high as RMB215 billion and the number of commercial
                                              members exceeding 57 million.

      財務報表以人民幣呈列，金額湊整至最接                The financial statements are presented in
      近的千元。編製財務報表所用的計量基準                RMB rounded to the nearest thousand. The
      為歷史成本法，惟會計政策所述的投資物                measurement basis used in the preparation
      業（見附註 2(h)）、按公允價值計量且其變            of the financial statements is the historical
      動計入當期損益的金融資產及按公允價值                cost basis except that investment property

      編製符合香港財務報告準則的財務報表需                The preparation of financial statements
      要管理層作出判斷、估計及假設，而該等                in conformity with HKFRSs requires
      判斷、估計及假設會影響政策的應用及所                management to make judgements,
      呈報的資產、負債、收入及開支數額。該                estimates and assumptions that affect
      等估計及相關假設乃根據過往經驗及認為                the application of policies and reported
      於該等情況下乃屬合理的各項其他因素而                amounts of assets, liabilities, income and
